item.title: Wyden pledges to keep hold on nominee to lead CISA
item.description: Wyden said he will continue to object to Sean Plankey’s nomination until CISA releases a 2022 report on security flaws in the U.S. telecommunications system.

item.title: Odds for Howard Lutnick to Leave Trump Cabinet After Epstein Files Revelation
item.description: Odds for Howard Lutnick to Leave Trump Cabinet After Epstein Files Revelation

item.title: How to turn a lifetime of savings into a steady retirement paycheck
item.description: "One of the biggest things that we like to remind people is that when you hit retirement you have to start managing your money in reverse," Thiago Glieger said.

item.title: Facing harsh federal workforce realities, how can leaders motivate teams?
item.description: "The leadership part is understanding what you're able to do and what you're not able to do, and engage the workforce in that conversation," Dave Lebryk said.

item.title: Real-time rewrite of federal buying rules is roiling acquisition
item.description: "It signals that there's some openness to looking at creative ways to leverage this tool and deliver better value," Emily Murphy said.

item.title: Congressional leaders say ICE deal is still possible despite divisions
item.description: Congressional leaders say ICE deal is still possible despite divisions

item.title: VA EHR reboot aims for faster deployments after years of delays and outages
item.description: VA Deputy Secretary Paul Lawrence says the department is staffing up at sites preparing to use the new Electronic Health Record later this year.

item.title: Interior Dept directs IT shop to ‘scrub’ non-English content from its websites
item.description: A new disclaimer on Interior Department websites states “English is the official language and authoritative version of all federal information.”

item.title: AFGE seeks emergency order to block further FEMA cuts
item.description: AFGE and other plaintiffs want to stop FEMA from resuming layoffs that began in early 2026, but were temporarily paused due to last month's major winter storm.

item.title: Federal employees put into revived ‘Schedule F’ category may lose loan aid, pay incentives
item.description: Additional Schedule Policy/Career guidance follows the Trump administration's final rule to strip job protections from certain career federal employees.
